# Data dictionary — `wide.csv` (ZenTrade game)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:dictionary` from server/src/wide.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

One row per player who **reached the report card** (S14) and did **not withdraw** their data.
Behaviour columns are recomputed from the raw event log; the trap score uses the same function
as the report card. Download it from `/admin` → wide.csv. Yes/no columns use `1` = yes, `0` = no;
a blank cell means "not applicable" or "not answered". Amounts are in virtual ₹. Stage numbers
(S1–S15) are listed in `docs/screens.md`.

Total columns: 106.

**Other exports** (raw, for checking): `participants.csv` (one row per consented participant),
`events.csv` (append-only behaviour log: `ts` = server time in ms, `client_ts` = ms since page load,
`screen`, `event_type`, `payload` JSON) and `responses.csv` (one row per participant × item).
Data from the original survey flow (before the game) is only in the raw files. Withdrawn
participants are excluded from all four files; pilot participants are included and
flagged with `is_pilot = 1`.

## Identifiers & assignments

| Column | Description | Hypotheses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `participant_id` | Random UUID created at consent | — |
| `is_pilot` | 1 = joined through a `?pilot=1` link (exclude from analysis), 0 = real participant | — |
| `created_at` | Consent time (ISO, UTC) | — |
| `completed_at` | Time the report card (S14) was reached (ISO, UTC) | — |
| `skin` | IV. `honest` ("ZenTrade") or `fraud` ("ZenTrade X", dark-design layer); stored as `app_version` plain / fraud | H1, H1a–H1g |
| `round1_outcome` | IV. Round-1 result: `small_win` (+8%) or `flat` (0%) | H2 |
| `pool_source` | IV. Diamond Pool invite: `friend` message or sponsored `ad` | H5 |
| `withdrawal_offer` | IV. Test withdrawal (S9): `allowed` or `not_offered` | H6 |
| `reinvest_framing` | IV. Gold Plan offer (S10): `profit` (from Profit wallet) or `main` (from Main wallet) | H7 |
| `deal_order` | Order the flash deals were shown, ₹ (e.g. `8000;500;3000`) | H3 (order control) |
| `spin_order` | Order the bonus spins were shown (win amounts, ₹) | H4 (order control) |

## App behaviour (event log)

| Column | Description | Hypotheses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `decision_time_first_invest` | Seconds from first render of the home dashboard (S3) to the first Invest / Skip tap | H1, H1a, H1e |

## Derived scores

| Column | Description | Hypotheses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crt_score` | Cognitive Reflection Test score 0–3 (correct: 5, 5, 47) | H1 (moderator) |
| `lambda` | Loss aversion λ from the bonus spins = smallest accepted gain ÷ ₹100 (0.5–3.0); 3.5 if all rejected; blank if inconsistent | H4, H8, H9 |
| `la_consistent` | 1 = spin choices switch at most once (reject → accept), 0 = inconsistent | H4 |
| `la_accepted` | Number of the six spins accepted (0–6) | H4 |
| `literacy_score` | Big Three financial literacy score 0–3 ("don't know" = wrong) | H8 |
| `self_rated_literacy` | Self-rated "How good are you with money?" 1–7 (= `lit_self`) | H8 |
| `overconfidence` | z(self_rated_literacy) − z(literacy_score), z over the rows in this export (sample SD); blank if either SD is 0 | H8 |
| `feature_push_count` | Number of the 7 features answered "yes, it pushed me to invest" | H1h |
| `fomo_score` | Number of the 3 FOMO statements agreed with (0–3) | H5 (moderator), H9 |
